history.note: Pre-audit state retained the score clock/fades and generic cue plumbing, but had no extracted net stream/animation, no final $6F2A dribble placement, and incorrect or missing command-specific movement/roster cues.

Ghidra and Mesen established the exact score-net frames, commands $05/$08/$0C/$0D/$0E/$0F, final held-ball path, and separate One-on-One asset streams; all are integrated and deterministically checked.
Expanded the denominator for exact command words, score program $0C, movement program $11, focused square/sweep rendering, and take-out placement.
Added the previously generic dribble cue: command $0C maps to program $02/stream $3D7F and its exact six-frame channel-2 retrigger is serialized, bound, and WAV-exportable in asset-pack v7.

Corrected $78DD sound gating and $6F2A +$05 coordinates; added traced rim-miss/boundary recovery, $FFD1/$796C take-back including CPU flow, exact $0F/$0E programs, and the 35-frame roster-to-gameplay chime carry in asset-pack v8.
Corrected the final player/ball visual-side mismatch: $2945 maps player +$02 bit 4 directly to OAM X-flip bit 5, so player composition and $6F2A now use the same hand-side bit.

Expanded the denominator for corrected $6BBA/$6BD4 reachable court edges with scene-level CPU release, $70FD/$6A8C defender landing/reentry, exact $2945 foot baseline, $1F5F first-flight preservation plus $1E5B/$1E77 ground clearing, and extracted command-$09 noise in asset-pack v9.

Expanded the denominator for $2DD2->$21FA selected-roster palettes and verified shared body art, $7138 hoop-facing sideline shots, exact $6F2A/$077D/+10/$2B88 live-steal gates, and the complete $2CCA->$05A3->$0C49 charging/blocking flow with decoded command-$04 audio in asset-pack v10.

Expanded the denominator for $347B descriptor transposition, $702D/$6B34/$7F0A phase-two dunk display, $C12B/$69F5 score-ball/net priority, corrected identical $7FC7/$7FCB shot offsets, and the full $C178->$067C take-back violation; asset-pack v11 carries the corrected $07B1 navigation cue.
